Class VisionSystem

java.lang.Object
yall.VisionSystem
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class VisionSystem extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Several VisionCameras working together, from any mix of vendors. 
VisionSystem vision = new VisionSystem(frontLimelight, backPhoton, sideSynapse);

public void periodic() {
  vision.setRobotOrientation(poseEstimator.getEstimatedPosition().getRotation(), gyro.getYawRate());
  vision.update();
  vision.addVisionMeasurements(poseEstimator);
}

public void simulationPeriodic() {
  vision.updateSimulation(drivetrainSim.getPose());
}

Add every estimate to your drivetrain's pose estimator with addVisionMeasurements(PoseEstimator), or with forEachEstimatedPose(Consumer) for a drivetrain with its own addVisionMeasurement method. Each estimate goes in on its own, with the time its image was taken and its own standard deviations, so the pose estimator applies it against the odometry from that moment and trusts each camera as much as it should. Don't combine the cameras' estimates first: that loses their timestamps and standard deviations.
